sn17.26:1.2: Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā va brāhmaṇā vā lābhasakkārasilokassa samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañcanissaraṇañca yāthābhūtaṃ napajānanti || || Evam kātabbam || || 3 Ye ca kho keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā lābhasakkārasilokassa samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam
